title: Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame's shares surged 188% in their Shanghai debut, giving Enflame a market cap of $26.3B, after raising ~$910M in an IPO (Ann Cao/South China Morning Post)
summary: Ann Cao / South China Morning Post: Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame's shares surged 188% in their Shanghai debut, giving Enflame a market cap of $26.3B, after raising ~$910M in an IPO — The Tencent-backed company sees share price surge, highlighting Enflame's role in Beijing's push for domestic chips amid US export restrictions
